description: Positional (ordinal) references: GROUP BY 1 and ORDER BY 2 address SELECT-list items BY POSITION, including an item that is an EXPRESSION rather than a column, and they mix freely with named references in the same clause list. An ordinal beyond the SELECT list's width is refused. Converted 1:1 from query/PositionalOrdinalsTest (now retired); the Java read cells by index, so each converted test pins the whole ordered row set.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t (r VARCHAR, n INTEGER)
SELECT r, SUM(n) FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
CREATE TABLE t (r VARCHAR, n INTEGER)
SELECT r, SUM(n) FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1
CREATE TABLE t (r VARCHAR, n INTEGER)
SELECT UPPER(r), COUNT(*) AS c FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY c DESC, 1
CREATE TABLE t (r VARCHAR, n INTEGER)
SELECT r, n FROM t ORDER BY 5
